newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, Canada to start air link this year.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, Canada to start air link this year.

text.p: Canada hopes to start an air link with Indonesia this year and carriers from both countries are in talks on possible routes, the Canadian ambassador said on Tuesday.
"We have the air agreement in place and we have the designated air carriers. I hope this year we will have some aircraft flying," Gary Smith told a news conference.

He said Garuda Indonesia and Air Canada had not yet decided where aircraft flying from Jakarta to Vancouver and vice versa should refuel and added that the Canadian carrier expected to have three flights a week.
"We are hoping to reach an agreement in a not too distant future. We can't get to Jakarta without refuelling," said Smith. He gave no further details.
He said at least 15,000 Indonesian tourists visited Canada a year. Smith gave no breakdown on the number of Canadians visiting Indonesia.
Smith was speaking when announcing events to be held in Indonesia in connection with Canada's Year of Asia Pacific, which is promoting relations with Asian countries.
